INSERT INTO services (instance_id, name, module_name, status, pid, port)
        VALUES ('test-instance', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (instance_id, name) DO UPDATE SET
            module_name = EXCLUDED.module_name,
            status = EXCLUDED.status,
            pid = EXCLUDED.pid,
            port = EXCLUDED.port
